properties.claim: Raw input delivery implements TeX82's M/N/S tokenizer, control-sequence scanning, superscript reduction, line retirement, token-list replay, and no-new-control-sequence guard.
preconditions: The exact eight-bit TeX82 profile is active.
Catcodes and endlinechar are the values committed before the next token boundary.
stimulus: Deliver physical source lines and token-list levels containing spaces, comments, endlines, control words and symbols, active characters, superscript notation, and macro parameters.
expected_observations: M/N/S state transitions emit or suppress spaces and paragraph tokens exactly at the canonical line boundary.
Control sequences and active characters preserve canonical spelling and source ranges.
Superscript notation reduces only complete canonical forms and restarts tokenization after invalid reductions.
Token-list parameters replay the selected argument without re-tokenizing it.
postconditions: The source or token-list cursor advances by exactly the consumed canonical input.
Scanner state and control-sequence creation policy remain owned by CommandState.
equivalence_cases: LF, CR, CRLF, and missing-final-terminator inputs share the same normalized tokenizer contract.
All canonical dialect profiles use the same exact-byte tokenizer.
recovery_cases: An invalid reduced character is consumed once before delivery restarts.
force_eof retires the current source only at the canonical refill boundary.
